newsitem.title: USA: Merisel sees profitability in six months.
newsitem.headline: Merisel sees profitability in six months.

text.p: Merisel Inc said Friday that it would return to profitability within the next six months if it doesn't do so by year-end.
The computer products distributor said its 1996 business plan assumed it would not return to profitability until the fourth quarter 1996.

It issued the profitability statement after reporting third quarter results showing a third quarter loss of $117.1 million or $3.90 per share, compared to $0.01 in the year-ago quarter. The loss included items totalling $100.5 million.
